def letter_grade(score):
    grades = [
        (93, 'A'),
        (90, 'A-'),
        (87, 'B+'),
        (83, 'B'),
        (80, 'B-'),
        (77, 'C+'),
        (73, 'C'),
        (70, 'C-'),
        (67, 'D+'),
        (63, 'D'),
        (60, 'D-'),
    ]
    for threshold, grade in sorted(grades, reverse=True):
        if score >= threshold:
            return grade
    return 'F'
